items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Yeah we had piano, Joe James, the same piano player.

ctx.x: Most people don't say those things.

No, they ain't got nothing. I'm the only one got them pictures. So, alright. Like, you take like the uniforms. We used to wear a uniform, we had a jacket, a blue jacket, with a dark lapel, you know what I mean? And, blue pants with stripes. And, you know what I mean? None of them fellas don't have the jacket and the pants. I'm still got them. You stayed here? And that been years ago. I even got them white pants we used to wear. Even got that. See? You know what? Sometimes boys see me, we say, man, what? See, they…
Where you live in? He lives out on, oh near Roman Street.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Me, Joe, me, Joe, and the boy, Buckeye, with the Buckeye. That's three pieces.

ctx.x: Me, Joe, me, Joe, and the boy, Buckeye, with the Buckeye. That's three pieces. What did he play?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And we used to play in there, three pieces, me, Joey and that boy, Buckeye.

ctx.x: I remember someplace, I'll look it up in my notes.

But this boy, his boy was an Italian boy, his name was Sam you know. So well we used to play there on Wednesday, Friday, and we couldn't play Saturday because we was playing in wrestling you see, every Saturday. Then after that the war, then the war, second war, broke out. So that made us, we was playing on Chapitula, we was playing for this fella so that's why this fella, Speck, he wanted us to wait for him. He's building a new dance hall. Moulin Rouge. Moulin Rouge, you see. In fact, Speck already had a dance…
That's when the new sheriff came in there.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: So me Wilford, George James, three of us played in the room.

ctx.x: Yeah. T. Rouch, or no, no, I mean not him. Bikes. And that boy would do Rodney, that boy plays. He was playing. Then I had with the chorus playing, you know, he play with Fat Domino now. He used to play guitar. He played bass with Fat Domino. Little short fella. Oh I know, Jimmy Davis. Yeah, Jim. From up to Carrollton. Yeah, little Jim. Little Jim played with us a long time. And then on his rope rope. He told me that you told me. Yeah, on his rope rope, playing with me there. You know what I mean? But I'll tell…
